en: Teenagers really can't stand their parents, huh...
Heck no...

Anyway, I should get going.
I really don't have time to waste.

What about the time leap?
I guess you don't believe in it, huh?
Yup. Time's up.

Besides, if you really <font_kind=yakuza_italic>are</font_kind> telling the truth,
you must have a reason to be back in 2016.
I shouldn't keep you from it.
I actually don't have a reason.

I only discovered my time leap power
a couple of days ago, after all.

I've been trying t'figure out where I got it,
but my search has come up empty so far.

So, I decided to test out a few time leaps
to see what my limits were!

In that case, let me know if you learn anything.
See you later.
Huhhh?

Hey Mister, can we talk about my time leap?
I wanna prove I'm not just messing with you.
Wanna let me explain in a bit more detail?

What do I do...?
I'm gonna be stuck here forever...

Huh? 
Oh, it's you, Kiryu-san.

Remember me? Miku!
I'm the time leaper...

Of course I remember.
What's wrong? Why the tears?

Um, it's a kinda long story.
Do y'wanna listen, Kiryu-san?
Nah, maybe some other time.
Right. You must be busy, Kiryu-san.

Of course. I wouldn't just abandon you.
So go on, let's hear what you have to say.

Um, well... The thing is...
I... I lost my time leap powers!

I knew it.
You still don't believe me, do you?

I'm not lying t'ya, though!
I really <font_kind=yakuza_italic>can</font_kind> leap through time!

Let's suppose you can, then.
How exactly do you do it?

I just close my eyes and think back to
a moment I wanna revisit. That's all it takes.

My first time leap was right after
I said something really horrible to my dad.

I wanted t'take back what I said, so I prayed.
Prayed that I could go back.
What exactly did you say to him?

Well, my dad's really lame. He doesn't have any
self-confidence, and barely even acts like a dad.

Because of that, my mom...
She started cheatin' on him.

The family was falling apart. My dad knew about
the affair, but was too afraid t'say anything.

Then one humid day, my mom was out neglecting
our family again. Probably was out with her boytoy.

I got a bad grade on a test that day, too.
And on top of that, the sink was totally busted.

That's when... I snapped. I took it all out on my dad,
even though my mom was the real problem.

I blamed him for mom's affair.
Called him a coward for not confronting her...

And my dad just sat there crying. All because of me...
But that just made it harder t'stop!
I get it. That stuff's not easy for a kid.

That's when I leapt back to before I yelled at him.
This time I didn't say any of that stuff.
I'm really glad I got a redo.

I've been obsessed with time leaps since then.
I couldn't stop reading sci-fi books from the library.
They helped me forget about how sad my life was.

But now for some reason...
my time leap power's totally gone.

What can I do?
If I'm stuck here, I...

Look, Miku.
I'm not so sure this is a problem.

You only went a year into the past.
Can't you just wait until you're back in 2017?

Well, I'd normally agree with you.
But...

...I can't go through all of that again!
I can't stand another year with my dad!
Miku... I'm sorry.
Heyyy! Miku!
Ah... Dad?

Hey, I'm just headin' on home now.
Y'wanna come with?
Uh, but...
Who's this fella?

Oh, this is Kiryu-san.
I only just met him.

I'm Kiryu. Don't worry,
I'll make sure your daughter gets back safe.

Will y'now? Ah, that's awful nice.
Hope she ain't causin' ya trouble.

Anyway Miku, I'm hittin' the road.
Mom says she's cookin' up a feast tonight!

Your story doesn't add up. Your dad seems fine,
and it sounds like he gets along with your mom, too.
Oh yeah... This is before everything changed...

I remember now!
Dad! Don't go that way!
Dad!
Oh, my apologies.
Owwwwww! Man that hurts!
Huh? But, I didn't mean...

Ya broke my arm, ya piece o' shit!
It's gonna cost ya, y'hear? Ugh, it hurts!
Please, um... Please forgive me!

Get down on yer knees n' beg!
I ain't gonna let you off that easy, y'hear!?

No... I've seen this happen before.
They made Dad kneel down to them, and then...
A-Ahhh!

Don't worry, Miku. What you're about to see
is probably different from the future you know.
Hey, keep your hands off him.
Huh? N' who're you?

I'm the one who's going to change history.
Now if you're done talking... Bring it on!
Kiryu-san... Can you hear me out?

It's kinda a long story...
but I wanna talk about time leaps again.

Thank you so much, Kiryu-san.
History's been changed because of you.

What originally happened was, those thugs forced
my dad to kneel and then they just beat on him.

They totally humiliated him here on this bridge.
My dad probably didn't want me t'see him like that.

He was always so cheerful, but from that day on,
he wouldn't even look me in the eye.

That's when things got bad at home, too.
He and my mom barely talked after that.
They used t'be so close...

So thanks to your time leap, you managed
to rewrite some bitter history?

Yup. If I had t'guess, I'd say that's why
I got my powers in the first place.

Well, Kiryu-san? Do you believe my story?
Do you think I really leapt through time?

No way.
Your word is all I have to go on, after all.
Geez, you don't trust me at all!?

I'm not sure if the power to redo the past
really exists in this world.

You only get one chance at life. You're born once,
and you die once. The same applies to you.

But you can change the middle as much as you want.
Don't forget that.

Hey, Kiryu-san.
Is there anything you'd wanna do over?

I'm not sure. I try to let the past
stay in the past. That's how it works for me.

Well, if I <font_kind=yakuza_italic>do</font_kind> manage to time leap again,
I'll come prove it to you, Kiryu-san.

Tell me what happens in the races, then.
If you're right about that, I'll believe you.

Will do! Bye now, Kiryu-san!
Thank you so much for everything!
No problem.
Hey, watch where you're standin'!
Hey, are you okay...!?

Can you move?
Come on, answer me.
You should be checkin' on her instead...
Hm? <font_kind=yakuza_italic>Her</font_kind>...?
I'm all right, somehow.
Huh? Why am I over there?

The hell's this shit?
My own body's... in front of me?

H-H-Huh? What's going on?
Huh!?
Is this some kinda dream or somethin'...?
What is their problem?
Lady Kazumiii! L-Lady Kazumi!

Let me get this straight. The shock from
the fall made you guys switch bodies?
Yes. That's how it seems.
It don't make any sense to me, either...

So, you're Kazuo... and the one in that body is Kazumi.
Even your names are confusing.

Th-This is ridiculous.
It's not possible!
Stay calm, Muranaka.

You brat!
How dare you take that tone with me!?

You sure that's how you wanna talk to her?
Ain't she supposed to be your master?

Enough joking around, Lady Kazumi!
We need to get you to a hospital at once.

It's fine, I ain't hurt or nothing.
We've got way bigger problems than that right now.

Your name's Kiryu-san, right? Sorry,
but mind not tellin' anyone about this?
Not that anyone's gonna believe you, anyways.

Kazuo-kun... How are you so calm right now?
This is no time for joking around!
Tch, enough of this charade...

Madam, I must insist that you
return home!
Fine, then Kazumi should come along...

What...?
But Muranaka...!

I've said it enough times, thugs like him
are not permitted at our residence.

C'mon, you thick-headed butler.
Even you gotta realize the mistake you're makin'.

We've got to stick together or there's
no way we'll figure out how to swap back...

Now, enough of this strange behavior!
We're leaving, Madam!

Kazumi, it'll be okay.
I'll have someone come pick you up right away!

Yo... Kazuo, was it?
Er, Kazumi for now, I guess.

Is everything okay?
It sounded like you guys are in a complicated situation.

Complicated wouldn't even cut it...
Am I going to be in Kazuo-kun's body forever...?
Hey... Aw crap.
Crying isn't gonna fix anything...

A guy's body isn't so bad, y'know.
You can piss standing up now, so that's something...

Nah, I guess you'd rather look for a
way to get your own body back, huh?
If there's any way I could help you out...
Hm? Are you okay...?

No matter how hard you fall down the stairs,
people don't just swap bodies with each other, man!
So this was all an act...
Yep, you got it.

So you guys were lying about the
body swap thing the whole time?

I guess if it were that easy, this sorta thing
would've happened to a lot of people by now.

I-I don't know w-what to tell you...
but it happened...

But that means you and that girl are accomplices.
Why don't you drop the act already?

So it was an act after all, huh?
Everything including falling down the stairs...

If you need to cry,
I'll lend you my shoulder to cry on.

Even though you're in a guy's body, you're a girl inside,
right? I can't just leave a lady in distress.
Come over here, Kazumi.

Kiryu-san, was it?
I feel bad about dragging you into all of this...
But we have our own reasons for doing it.
And what reason is that?

Kazumi, the girl I claimed to switch places with...
she belongs to the Iwami family.
The Iwami family...?

Yeah, she's not part of the head family, but she's
pretty damn close. Basically... her family's loaded.

No one would believe that Kazumi
is dating a guy like me.
Yeah, I bet...

For a girl as privileged as Kazumi, she's a good person.
She looks at who you are, not where you came from.

And to get to the point...
we're in a serious relationship.

But the people around us... especially that butler,
Muranaka, are desperately trying to break us apart.

He convinced her parents to send her away for school.
If that happens, we may never see each other again.

I see. So that's why you made up that act...
You guys didn't really have another choice.

If your daughter swaps bodies with someone, you can't
exactly break 'em up until they swap back, y'know?
I doubt anyone would totally believe it.

That's the thing, they don't need to believe it 100%.
You just need them to believe it's possible.

As long as we keep playing our parts, they should
believe just enough to keep the two of us together.
What a bizarre idea. Did you come up with it?

Nah, it's all her.
She got it from a movie or something.
Oh, hold up, Kiryu-san.

It's Muranaka...
Kazumi probably sent him to pick me up...

Nah... if that were the case,
there wouldn't be so many people.

In any case, I'm gonna act like Kazumi again,
so could you play along?

Muranaka! You've come to pick me up, yes?
Where's Kazuo-kun?

You have no business here.
Leave us to our affairs.
And if I don't?
If you stay, you'll suffer alongside him.

What is the meaning of this...?
Answer me, Muranaka!

You shitty brat...
How long do you plan to keep up this act?

No, this... isn't an act!
I really swapped bodies with Kazuo-kun...!

How's that? If you don't want to get hurt,
stop this disgusting act now.

No, Muranaka. It's really me, Kazumi.
Please believe me...!

Uh-huh, you just don't know when to give up...
Let's see which gives out first, you or your lies...
How's that!? Give up and apologize already!
My name... is Kazumi!
You brat...!
I have nothing to do with any of this, but...

I can't stand by and watch when
someone lays their hands on a woman.

You're not from around here, are you?
You should have left while you had the chance.
I'll teach you what happens...
When an outsider meddles in someone else's affairs!
Kazuo-kun!? What happened to you!? And this is...
I'm so sorry about Muranaka.

Please forgive me, Kazuo-kun...
I didn't think Muranaka could be so cruel...
I'm fine, don't worry about me.
But Kiryu-san... why'd you step in to help me?
You knew that this was all an act. So why...?

No matter how much you got hurt,
you never stopped saying you were really Kazumi.

Maybe I just believed for a moment
that you really were Kazumi.

Sometimes, a lie that you risk your life for
can be true to someone... but only sometimes.
So? What are you guys gonna do now?
We're gonna continue this act, right...?

Yup... and if Muranaka attacks me again,
I'll tell him that you have my back, Kiryu.

Do what you want. I won't guarantee
that I'll actually come, though.

But... I wonder how long
we'd have to keep this up...
Yeah... I wouldn't mind keeping it going forever, though.

If it's with you, I could lie forever.
We only need to be true to each other.
Kazuo... kun...
Can't you two do that in private?
